arStrings.szText: {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} creates a {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c} at the impact location which deals {c_number}{payload:BS_PAYLOAD_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage when it explodes.

{c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} is now also a {c_important}Demonology Summon{/c} Skill and creates a turret demon on impact for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds that spits lava at surrounding enemies, each dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_TURRET}{/c} damage. You can have up to {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} turrets active at a once.

{c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} Skill and now lobs a cluster of {c_number}6{/c} smaller shadow orbs which each deal {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_MINI}{/c} damage. Casting another {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} splits the previous cluster midflight.
{c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} deals up to {c_number}[{SF_18}*{SF_19}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage based on how far it travels.
{c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} additional Wrath on each impact.

{c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|%|]{/c} chance to Knock Down enemies for {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} seconds. When {c_important}Molten Bomb{/c} is empowered by {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} this chance is increased to {c_number}[100|%|]{/c}. Can occur once every {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} seconds per enemy.
{c_important}Molten Bomb's{/c} impact area is increased by {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|%|]{/c} and does {c_number}[{SF_25}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to enemies at its center.
